name: provenance-claude-replication-arm-v1

relationship_to_frozen_study.primary_model: gpt-5.6-luna at low reasoning via the Codex CLI adapter
relationship_to_frozen_study.statement: This is a separately reported secondary arm, not a change to the frozen study. No frozen question, condition, prompt, inclusion rule, split, episode, or retained Luna call is altered, reinterpreted, replaced, or removed. The frozen study's primary F-versus-G comparison remains the Luna arm.

reason: The frozen study's sealed model calls were made from a sandboxed Codex CLI session against gpt-5.6-sol and gpt-5.6-luna. That session and those models are not available on the current host.

The nine retained sealed captures, their provenance bundles, parity audits, and the pinned crane_ml checkout are all present, so the model arm is re-runnable against a different model family without recapturing anything.
Whether the F/G/H contrast survives a change of model family and agent harness is a real and reportable robustness question for RQ4.

design.episodes: the nine already-included sealed rows pn-0001 through pn-0009, reused exactly as captured
design.prompts: the frozen committed prompt files, byte-unchanged
design.evidence: the retained parity-audited runtime presentations and the exact pinned repository checkout
design.model: selected by the predeclared control at research/explanation_fidelity/experiment_configs/development/provenance-model-strength-claude-20260920-v1.json, on development episodes only

data_separation.statement: Claude-arm artifacts never share a path, filename, cache, manifest, annotation file, or analysis result with the frozen Luna arm.

adapter_differences_from_the_codex_arm: The Codex CLI enforces a read-only filesystem sandbox. The Claude Code CLI exposes no equivalent flag, so the adapter denies every mutating, network, and delegation tool, runs only inside a throwaway extraction of the pinned checkout, and hashes the entire workspace before and after each call. A call whose workspace hashes changed is retained and raised, never scored.

The Codex CLI accepts an out-of-band --output-schema. The Claude Code CLI does not, so the answer schema is delivered in-band through a fixed, model-agnostic suffix appended by the adapter. The frozen prompt files are unchanged; the suffix is recorded in every retained request.

The F and H agent harness differs: codex exec versus the Claude Code CLI agent, which carries its own system prompt and a Read/Glob/Grep/Bash tool surface. F and H are therefore 'a generic coding agent of that family', not the identical agent program.
The Claude Code CLI reports provider monetary cost; the Codex ChatGPT-login path did not. Cost is reported for this arm and remains unavailable for the Luna arm.
claims_this_arm_may_support: Whether the direction and rough magnitude of the F/G/H contrast on these nine retained episodes reproduce under a different model family and agent harness.
Descriptive sensitivity of the primary comparison to model family, reported separately and labeled as such.
Resource evidence (tokens, latency, and monetary cost) for the Claude family on identical inputs.
claims_this_arm_may_not_support: Any increase in independent sample size. The episodes are the same nine episodes; the two arms are not 50 additional clusters and must never be pooled as independent observations.
Any equivalence, superiority, or inferiority claim between the Claude and GPT model families. The arm is a single-sample replication, not a matched model comparison with its own power analysis.
Any replacement of the frozen primary result. If the arms disagree, both are reported.
Any relief from the frozen 40-episode minimum, which remains unmet at nine included episodes in both arms.

sealed_answer_discipline.statement: Claude-arm sealed answers are subject to the same rule as the Luna arm: they are retained and hashed but are not inspected or scored until the blinded dual-annotation workflow is ready.

known_validity_threats: Nine included episodes against a frozen minimum of forty.
Single unblinded automated annotator for the development model-strength control.
Agent-harness difference between F/H in the two arms is a confound with model family; the arms differ in more than the model weights.
The Claude Code CLI read-only contract is enforced by tool denial plus workspace hashing rather than by a kernel-level sandbox.
